note: System pass criterion (prereg): juror-gated defendant vs frontier self-review on false-claim rate + cost. Test split, 10 articles.

defendant.judge: qwen3.8-27b (27B), claim + question context, 15/15 manual spot-checks verified

jury_gated.gate: WCT-EM consensus P(PASS) >= 0.5 on seeded proposition, ft reason_included 4-family panel

self_review_gated.gate: 27B self-review 3-state vote == PASS on seeded proposition

bootstrap.note: degenerate: defendant makes 0 false claims, so both gated rates are exactly 0

usd_proxy_per_1M.assumption: 4B class $0.20 in / $0.60 out; 27B class $1.00 in / $3.00 out (amortized serving proxy)

cost_test_split_10_articles.breakeven: jury cheaper for any pricing where 4B-class per-token price < 25.4% of 27B-class (i.e. small models >= 4x cheaper per token, true under realistic amortized serving)

detection_context.note: defendant is near-perfect on seeded ENTAIL claims, so false-claim comparison is low-power; the more informative 'catching' comparison is on pool counterfactuals (CONTRADICT)
detection_context.reading: self-review remains the stronger single catcher (98.7% vs 83-90.5%); jury's value is AUC 0.99 at a fraction of the cost, not beating self-review on catch rate
